recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 淋巴結中，原本結構被模糊、大小相近的結節（nodule）取代，結節邊界不清、缺乏明顯的外套區（mantle zone）與亮暗分區，是濾泡性淋巴瘤低倍下的線索。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by vaguely nodular, closely packed lymphoid nodules
Nodules are poorly delineated with attenuated or absent mantle zones
Nodules appear relatively uniform in size and staining, without visible polarization or tingible-body macrophages at this power
Thin vessels coursing between nodules; little interfollicular tissue
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by closely packed, vaguely nodular lymphoid proliferation. The nodules are ill-defined and relatively monotonous, with thin or absent mantle zones and no discernible polarization at this magnification. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed. The pattern is suggestive of follicular lymphoma, which should be confirmed by higher-power cytology and immunohistochemistry (CD10, BCL6, BCL2, CD21).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have well-formed mantle zones, polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and are BCL2 negative in germinal centers.
NLPBL nodules are large, pale and composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP (popcorn) cells rather than centrocytes and centroblasts.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells without centroblasts and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: NMZL shows pale marginal-zone cells around residual follicles and is CD10 negative, while follicular colonization shows disrupted CD21 meshworks.
